name: Recorder
description: Record a sample from the mics, the line-in or the pads, and trim it to a loop
changelog: 0.8.0: FX beside FROM -- a window with PITCH (KEEP LENGTH: transposed, the length and the bars kept; TAPE: varispeed, as a turntable), LOW PASS and HIGH PASS, LISTEN and APPLY; APPLY renders a copy of the take beside it (<name>_p+3k_l8000.wav) and puts it on screen with the markers on the same sound, and on an Arrange block (CLIP EDIT) the block plays it at once, one commit Arrange's undo takes back -- after TAPE with the part it plays and its bars following; requires core 2.28.

0.7.0: NORM on an Arrange block (CLIP EDIT) lands on its track at once -- the block plays the normalized copy from then on, same bar and same part of the file, one commit Arrange's undo takes back; before, only the Recorder's screen had it until ARR and PUT.

0.6.0: NORM -- the take brought up to -0.3 dB of full scale, as a copy beside it (<name>_norm.wav) that is then on screen with the markers where they were; the take itself is never written over, and one already at the peak is left as it is. LOOP and 1b are as narrow as PLAY, SAVE is a word, to make room
0.5.2: a new track or an empty bar from Arrange opens an empty Recorder: the last session's take stayed on screen and ARR offered it for the new track.

0.5.1: builds on core 1.70+/gui 1.28+ and on core/gui 2.x (>=1.70.0,<3.0.0 and >=1.28.0,<3.0.0) for the merge window; a root deleted before the app's teardown is handled (gui 2.0 calls destroy with none)

0.5.0: Opened from Arrange's CLIP EDIT on an audio block, the Recorder loads that block's clip with the markers on the part of the file the block plays; ARR puts the trimmed clip back on the block's bar in place of the block it came from (one undo step), or goes back without a change.
0.4.2: focus is a white frame inside the button, not the theme's ring -- that stands 4 px out and the 22 px rows cut it to brackets
0.4.1: A value being turned reads dark on the accent: the text colour sits on the button, which is the only thing ever EDITED, not on its label
0.4.0: USB input -- what the computer plays into the board over USB audio, before the mixer's fader; says so when the board is not in its USB audio profile; requires core 1.28

0.3.0: PRE -- a bar or two of count-in before a take with the song, the beats counted down; FILES browses the whole card a folder at a time (paged); SAVE always writes into the recordings; requires core 1.27

0.2.0: SYNC -- REC plays the open song from bar FROM and the take lines up with it (frame 0 on that bar, the codecs' delay taken off), the time as bar.beat; ARRANGE puts the marked loop on a track of the song, a synced take where it was sung; requires core 1.26
